Excellent! This is the OnHitNPC logic in Projectile.cs (:12467-12500). Key insight:

When a yoyo (aiStyle 99) hits an NPC:
- If ai[0] == -2 (detached): the yoyo bounces off — velocity /= 5, then vy -= rand(5,8.1), capped -16 (bounces upward like a dead yoyo being knocked). netUpdate.
- Else: calls `Main.player[owner].Counterweight(targetNPC.Center, damage, knockBack)` — this is the counterweight spawn! And direction faces, and if ai[0] >= 0: bounce velocity = -0.5*velocity + 16*dirAwayFromNPC, localAI[0] += 20 (shortens lifetime by 20 frames).

115	function tintedTex(tex: Tex, rgb: readonly [number, number, number], flatten: boolean): HTMLCanvasElement | null {
116	  const w = (tex as { width: number }).width, h = (tex as { height: number }).height;
117	  if (!w || !h) return null;
118	  let m = tintCache.get(tex);
119	  if (!m) { m = new Map(); tintCache.set(tex, m); }
120	  const key = `${rgb[0]},${rgb[1]},${rgb[2]}|${flatten ? 1 : 0}`;
121	  const hit = m.get(key);
122	  if (hit) return hit;
123	  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
124	  c.width = w; c.height = h;
125	  const cx = c.getContext('2d');
126	  if (!cx) return null;
127	  cx.drawImage(tex as CanvasImageSource, 0, 0);
128	  cx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';               // rgb = 贴图.rgb × 染色
129	  cx.fillStyle = `rgb(${rgb[0]},${rgb[1]},${rgb[2]})`;
130	  cx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
131	  if (!flatten) {                                         // 回贴原 alpha 形状
132	    cx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
133	    cx.drawImage(tex as CanvasImageSource, 0, 0);
134	  }
135	  cx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
136	  if (m.size > 64) m.clear();
137	  m.set(key, c);
138	  return c;
139	}
140	
141	/**
142	 * 单段线绘制（预乘混合精确等价，见文件头）：(x,y)=origin 落点（XNA position 语义），
143	 * rot=段角，segLen=段长（(int) 截断，Main.cs:27907/:35205 sourceRectangle 高）。
144	 */
145	function drawSegment(
146	  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, tex: Tex,
147	  x: number, y: number, rot: number, segLen: number,
148	  color: readonly [number, number, number, number],
149	): void {
150	  const h = Math.trunc(segLen);                           // Rectangle (int)num5
151	  if (h <= 0) return;
152	  const w = (tex as { width: number }).width;
153	  const a = color[3];
154	  ctx.save();
155	  ctx.translate(x, y);
156	  ctx.rotate(rot);
157	  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
158	  if (a === 0) {
159	    // 纯加色：摊平染色 + 'lighter'（A=0 预乘 = 背景零衰减）
160	    const t = tintedTex(tex, [color[0], color[1], color[2]], true);
161	    if (!t) { ctx.restore(); return; }
162	    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
163	    ctx.drawImage(t, 0, 0, w, h, -w / 2, 0, w, h);
164	  } else if (a >= 255) {
165	    // 纯替换：保形染色 source-over（钓线 GetColor alpha 重置 255 路径）
166	    const t = tintedTex(tex, [color[0], color[1], color[2]], false);
167	    if (!t) { ctx.restore(); return; }
168	    ctx.drawImage(t, 0, 0, w, h, -w / 2, 0, w, h);
169	  } else {
170	    // 中间档两笔：黑形压暗背景(×(1−A/255)) + 摊平染色 'lighter' 补贡献
171	    const black = tintedTex(tex, [0, 0, 0], false);
172	    const t = tintedTex(tex, [color[0], color[1], color[2]], true);
173	    if (!black || !t) { ctx.restore(); return; }
174	    ctx.globalAlpha = a / 255;
175	    ctx.drawImage(black, 0, 0, w, h, -w / 2, 0, w, h);
176	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
177	    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
178	    ctx.drawImage(t, 0, 0, w, h, -w / 2, 0, w, h);
179	  }
180	  ctx.restore();
181	}
182	
183	// ===================== 段链（两消费端共享的 12px 段循环） =====================
184	
185	/** 段链目标（Projectile 盒 + 速度；钓鱼线另带 lai0=localAI[0] 张力 0-100） */
186	export interface StringLineTarget {
187	  x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number;
188	  vx: number; vy: number;
189	  lai0?: number;
190	}
191	
192	/** 每段终色回调（消费端闭包：基色 → TryApplying → GetColor alpha 重置/×0.5） */
193	type SegmentColorFn = () => readonly [number, number, number, number];
194	
195	interface ChainArgs {
196	  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D;
197	  tex: Tex;
198	  /** 线起点（悠悠球=MountedCenter / 钓线=竿尖） */
199	  startX: number; startY: number;
200	  target: StringLineTarget;
201	  colorFn: SegmentColorFn;
202	  /** 悠悠球（'yoyo'）与钓线（'fishing'）的三处差异：
203	   *  起步回退 ×0.1 vs 全 12px（:27820/:35127）；首段不推进 vs 恒推进（:27843-27851）；
204	   *  摆垂 num8 ×f×0.5 vs ×(1−lai0/100)（:27874-27875/:35174-35175）；
205	   *  origin 落点 −(6,0) vs 无（:27907/:35205） */
206	  variant: 'yoyo' | 'fishing';
207	}
208	
209	/** 段链主体（钓线 :35112-35205 / 悠悠球线 :27801-27908 同构循环）：
210	 *  12px 段沿起点→目标推进，速度/张力摆垂（num8），逐段旋贴 FishingLine 竖条。
211	 *  ★线色求值次数：钓线 TryApplying 在循环【外】一次（:35013，29 号全帧同色）；
212	 *  悠悠球线在循环【内】逐段（:27899-27901，29 号逐段独立闪烁）。
213	 *  guard 上限为防御性护栏（原版无；终止条件 = 段距 <20 走尾段）。 */
214	function runSegmentChain(a: ChainArgs): void {
215	  const { ctx, tex, target, colorFn, variant } = a;
216	  const tw = (tex as { width: number }).width;
217	  const th = (tex as { height: number }).height;
218	  const fixedColor = variant === 'fishing' ? colorFn() : null;   // :35013 钓线一次
219	  let px = a.startX, py = a.startY;
220	  let num = target.x + target.w * 0.5 - px;               // :27804/:35112 目标=盒中心
221	  let num2 = target.y + target.h * 0.5 - py;
222	  let flag = true;
223	  let flag2 = true;                                       // :27809 悠悠球首段不推进
224	  if (num === 0 && num2 === 0) {
225	    flag = false;                                         // :27810/:35117
226	  } else {
227	    const k = 12 / Math.hypot(num, num2);                 // :27816-27819/:35123-35126
228	    num *= k; num2 *= k;
229	    if (variant === 'yoyo') {                             // :27820-27821 起步回退 ×0.1
230	      px -= num * 0.1; py -= num2 * 0.1;
231	    } else {                                              // :35127-35128 全 12px 回退
232	      px -= num; py -= num2;
233	    }
234	    num = target.x + target.w * 0.5 - px;
235	    num2 = target.y + target.h * 0.5 - py;
236	  }
237	  let guard = 512;
238	  while (flag && guard-- > 0) {
239	    let segLen = 12;                                      // :27827/:35134
240	    const dist = Math.hypot(num, num2);
241	    const dist0 = dist;                                   // num7
242	    if (Number.isNaN(dist)) { flag = false; continue; }   // :27830-27834/:35137-35141
243	    if (dist < 20) { segLen = dist - 8; flag = false; }   // :27835-27839/:35142-35146
244	    const k = 12 / dist;
245	    num *= k; num2 *= k;
246	    if (variant === 'yoyo') {                             // :27843-27851 首段不推进
247	      if (flag2) flag2 = false;
248	      else { px += num; py += num2; }
249	    } else {                                              // :35150-35151 恒推进
250	      px += num; py += num2;
251	    }
252	    num = target.x + target.w * 0.5 - px;
253	    num2 = target.y + target.h * 0.1 - py;                // :27852-27853/:35152-35153 段目标=盒顶 10%
254	    if (dist0 > 12) {                                     // :27854/:35154 摆垂（仅段距 >12）
255	      let sway = 0.3;
256	      let spd = Math.abs(target.vx) + Math.abs(target.vy);
257	      if (spd > 16) spd = 16;
258	      sway *= 1 - spd / 16;                               // :27862-27863
259	      let f = dist0 / 80;
260	      if (f > 1) f = 1;
261	      sway *= f;                                          // :27869/:35169
262	      if (sway < 0) sway = 0;                             // :27870-27873
263	      if (variant === 'yoyo') {
264	        sway *= f;                                        // :27874 悠悠球二次 ×f
265	        sway *= 0.5;                                      // :27875 ×0.5
266	      } else {
267	        sway *= 1 - (target.lai0 ?? 0) / 100;             // :35174-35175 张力收敛
268	      }
269	      if (num2 > 0) {                                     // :27876-27880/:35176-35180
270	        num2 *= 1 + sway;
271	        num *= 1 - sway;
272	      } else {                                            // :27881-27896/:35181-35196
273	        f = Math.abs(target.vx) / 3;
274	        if (f > 1) f = 1;
275	        f -= 0.5;
276	        sway *= f;
277	        if (sway > 0) sway *= 2;
278	        num2 *= 1 + sway;
279	        num *= 1 - sway;
280	      }
281	    }
282	    const rot = Math.atan2(num2, num) - Math.PI / 2;      // :27898/:35198
283	    // origin 落点（XNA position−screenPos+(W/2,H/2)：悠悠球线再 −(6,0)）
284	    const ax = px + tw * 0.5 - (variant === 'yoyo' ? 6 : 0);
285	    const ay = py + th * 0.5;
286	    drawSegment(ctx, tex, ax, ay, rot, segLen, fixedColor ?? colorFn()); // :27907/:35205
287	  }
288	}

290	// ===================== 两消费端入口 =====================
291	
292	/**
293	 * 悠悠球/配重球线（Main.cs:27799-27908，DrawProjDirect aiStyle 99 段）：
294	 * 基色 White、A 先 ×0.4（:27899-27900）→ TryApplyingPlayerStringColor【循环内逐段，
295	 * :27899-27901——29 号逐段独立闪烁】→ 非 29 时 GetColor（alpha 重置 255，光照由合成
296	 * 自动）→ 全通道 ×0.5（:27902-27907）。
297	 */
298	export function drawYoyoStringLine(
299	  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, tex: Tex,
300	  startX: number, startY: number, target: StringLineTarget,
301	  playerStringColor: number, opts: StringColorOpts,
302	): void {
303	  const colorFn = (): readonly [number, number, number, number] => {
304	    // :27899-27901 White + A×0.4 → TryApplying
305	    let c = tryApplyingPlayerStringColor(playerStringColor, [255, 255, 255, 102], opts);
306	    // :27903-27906 GetColor：非 29 → alpha 重置 255（光照=合成自动乘，此处只重置 A）
307	    if (playerStringColor !== 29) c = [c[0], c[1], c[2], 255];
308	    // :27907 全通道 ×0.5（(byte) 截断）
309	    return [btrunc(c[0] * 0.5), btrunc(c[1] * 0.5), btrunc(c[2] * 0.5), btrunc(c[3] * 0.5)];
310	  };
311	  runSegmentChain({ ctx, tex, startX, startY, target, colorFn, variant: 'yoyo' });
312	}
313	
314	/**
315	 * 钓鱼线（Main.cs:34967-35205）：基色=竿色（:34988-35010 (200,200,200,100)+逐竿覆写）
316	 * → TryApplyingPlayerStringColor【循环外一次，:35013——29 号全帧同色闪烁】→ 段色
317	 * GetColor（alpha 重置 255；29 免取光取原始色，:35199-35204）。段链摆垂带 lai0
318	 * 张力收敛（:35174-35175）。
319	 */
320	export function drawFishingStringLine(
321	  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, tex: Tex,
322	  startX: number, startY: number, target: StringLineTarget,
323	  baseColor: readonly [number, number, number],
324	  playerStringColor: number, opts: StringColorOpts,
325	): void {
326	  const colorFn = (): readonly [number, number, number, number] => {
327	    // :34988-35013 基色 (rgb,100) → TryApplying
328	    const c = tryApplyingPlayerStringColor(playerStringColor,
329	      [baseColor[0], baseColor[1], baseColor[2], 100], opts);
330	    // :35199-35204 GetColor alpha 重置 255（29 免取光：原始色 A=0 直用）
331	    if (playerStringColor === 29) return c;
332	    return [c[0], c[1], c[2], 255];
333	  };
334	  runSegmentChain({ ctx, tex, startX, startY, target, colorFn, variant: 'fishing' });
335	}

export function playerCanHitEnemy(
  e: unknown,
  game: GameHooks,
  projId = 0,
): boolean {
  const t = e as { vanillaId?: number | null; def?: { friendly?: boolean } } | null | undefined;
  if (!t?.def?.friendly) return true;
  if (projId === 318) return true;
  const vid = t.vanillaId ?? -1;
  const eq = (game.player as unknown as { equipStats?: { killGuide?: boolean; killClothier?: boolean } } | null)
    ?.equipStats;
  if (vid === 22 && eq?.killGuide) return true;
  if (vid === 54 && eq?.killClothier) return true;
  return false;
}

So with glove equipped and no yoyos in play, no counterweight spawns even with counterWeight > 0. Edge case — replicate exactly: the decision must encode the else-if structure.

```ts
export function counterweightDecision(eq, play, kb) {
  if (!eq.yoyoGlove && eq.counterWeight <= 0) return { kind: 'none' };   // :11947-11950
  let yoyoCount = 0, weightCount = 0;
  for (const p of play) {
    if (p.isWeight) { if (p.ai0 !== -2) weightCount++; }
    else if (p.ai0 !== -2) yoyoCount++;
  }
  if (eq.yoyoGlove && yoyoCount < 2) {
    if (yoyoCount >= 1) return { kind: 'second-yoyo' };   // num >= 0
    return { kind: 'none' };
  }
  if (eq.counterWeight > 0 && weightCount < yoyoCount) {
    return { kind: 'counterweight',
      type: eq.vanityCounterWeight !== 0 ? eq.vanityCounterWeight : eq.counterWeight,
      kb: (kb + 6) / 2,
      secondary: weightCount > 0 };
  }
  return { kind: 'none' };
}
```

0;\n    this.rot += 0.5; // :64489\n    // 超径钳回（:64540-64550）：钳到轨道 + 速度径向衰减（去超出的 num6）\n    let dx = p.cx - this.cx, dy = p.cy - this.cy;\n    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;\n    if (d > this.orbitR) {\n      const over = d - this.orbitR;\n      dx /= d; dy /= d;\n      this.x = p.cx - dx * this.orbitR - this.w / 2;\n      this.y = p.cy - dy * this.orbitR - this.h / 2;\n      const sp = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n      const cut = Math.min(over, Math.max(0, sp - 1)); // num6 钳（:64556）\n      if (sp > 0) { this.vx *= (sp - cut) / sp; this.vy *= (sp - cut) / sp; }\n    }\n    // 切向增速（:64552-64610）：vector2=(vy,vx) 按象限定号后并入速度方向\n    {\n      const sp0 = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n      if (sp0 > 0.5) {\n        let tx = this.vy, ty = this.vx; // vector2 翻转\n        if (this.cy < p.cy) ty = Math.abs(ty); else if (this.cy > p.cy) ty = -Math.abs(ty);\n        if (this.cx < p.cx) tx = Math.abs(tx); else if (this.cx > p.cx) tx = -Math.abs(tx);\n        let nvx = this.vx + tx, nvy = this.vy + ty;\n        const nl = Math.hypot(nvx, nvy) || 1;\n        nvx = nvx / nl * sp0; nvy = nvy / nl * sp0; // 保速转朝\n        if (Math.abs(tx) < 0.1 || Math.abs(ty) < 0.1) { this.vx = nvx; this.vy = nvy; }\n        else { this.vx = (nvx + this.vx * 2) / 3; this.vy = (nvy + this.vy * 2) / 3; } // :64588\n      }\n    }\n    this.x += this.vx;\n    this.y += this.vy;\n    hitEnemies(this, game, this.hitCd, 10, Math.sign(this.vx) || 1, this.armorPen);\n  }\n\n  draw(r: Renderer, cam: Camera): void {\n    // 线（配重球同走 aiStyle 99 段链，Main.cs:27799-27908——ai[0]>=0 != -2 命中）\n    const c = r.canvas.getContext('2d');\n    const tex = r.atlas?.ensureVImage?.('vanilla/FishingLine.png');\n    if (c && tex) {\n      drawYoyoStringLine(c, tex, this.handX, this.handY, this,\n        this.stringColor, stringColorOpts(r.lighting?.clock));\n    }\n    drawProj(r, cam, this, this.projId, this.rot + Math.PI / 2, '#B09060');\n  }\n}",
 "new_string": "// ================= 配重球（aiStyle 99 type 556-561/1079，AI_099_1 :64472-64824） =================\n// SetDefaults（:5805-5813）：10×10 命中盒、extraUpdates=1（AI/移动/命中每 tick 跑 2 次）、\n// DefaultToYoyo、counterweight=true、drawLayer=0。\n// ai[0] 状态机：0 主球 / 1 副球（Counterweight() 已有在场时掷,轨道半径 ×0.75,:64532）/\n//   -1 回收（松手 :64643-64646 或场上无悠悠球 :64491-64506）→ 飞回玩家 40px 内消亡\n//   （:64777-64824:num13=num3×1.5=18 速/惯性 12/>2000 亦亡;tileCollide=false 穿墙）/\n//   -3 魔法线幽灵（-1+magicString → 隐身零伤,:64727-64737）/ -2 脱离坠落（克隆,\n//   penetrate=1、撞墙即亡、重力 0.3 缓落漂移,:64738-64776 + :16988-17006）。\n// 环绕段：半径 num=250×0.5=125（yoyoString +25%+10,:64486-64488）；超径钳回轨道 +\n//   切向增速 vector2=(vy,vx) 翻转带象限符号（:64540-64608,仅超径时运行）；鼠标位移\n//   反推（vector5×-1×0.1,:64614-64642）；800px 内最近敌追踪 v3×6 lerp 1/8\n//   （:64643-64717,敌须距玩家 <num×0.9 且有视线）；速度钳 [num4=9,num3=12]\n//   （:64718-64726）。撞墙全轴反转 + 朝玩家 0.25 合成 + 钳 6（:17005-17028）。\n/** 配重球运行上下文（Game 注入闭包——实体不持 EntityManager 引用） */\nexport interface CounterweightCtx {\n  /** 拥有者（玩家中心/装备；null 或 dead → Kill,:64490-64493） */\n  owner: () => { cx: number; cy: number; dead?: boolean; equipStats?: { stringColor?: number; yoyoString?: boolean; magicString?: boolean } } | null;\n  /** Main.player[owner].channel 语义（按住使用中）——false → 回收（:64643-64646） */\n  channel: () => boolean;\n  /** 场上还有悠悠球（AI_099_1 :64488-64500 扫描门:aiStyle99 非配重球且 ai0>=-1） */\n  yoyoInPlay: () => boolean;\n  /** 本帧鼠标屏幕位移（Main.mouseX-lastMouseX,:64614） */\n  mouseDelta: () => { dx: number; dy: number };\n  /** 魔法线克隆回调（:64727-64733:-1 回收 + magicString → 掷 75% 伤/击退脱离克隆） */\n  spawnClone?: (x: number, y: number, vx: number, vy: number, dmg: number, kb: number, projId: number) => void;\n  /** 悠悠球命中链回调（Projectile.cs:12482 Player.Counterweight）——配重球命中同样触发 */\n  counterweight?: (hitX: number, hitY: number, dmg: number, kb: number) => void;\n}\n\nexport class CounterweightProj extends Entity {\n  /** SetDefaults :5808-5809 */\n  w = 10; h = 10;\n  damage: number;\n  knockback: number;\n  projId: number;\n  critChance = 0.04;\n  armorPen = 0;\n  meleeProj = true;\n  /** ai[0] 状态（0/1 环绕、-1 回收、-3 幽灵、-2 脱离） */\n  ai0: number;\n  private rot = 0;\n  private ctx: CounterweightCtx;\n  private hitCd = new HitCooldown();\n  /** 方向（-2 漂移/rotation 定号） */\n  private dir = 1;\n  dead = false;\n  /** 手部坐标 + 线色快照（线段链起点/染色，每 AI 次刷新） */\n  handX = 0;\n  handY = 0;\n  stringColor = 0;\n  /** -3 幽灵隐身（alpha=255,:64734-64736）——绘制侧消费 */\n  ghost = false;\n\n  constructor(x: number, y: number, damage: number, knockback: number, projId: number,\n    ai0: number, ctx: CounterweightCtx) {\n    super();\n    this.x = x; this.y = y;\n    this.damage = damage; this.knockback = knockback; this.projId = projId;\n    this.ai0 = ai0;\n    this.ctx = ctx;\n    this.handX = x; this.handY = y;\n  }\n\n  fixedUpdate(_dt: number, game: GameHooks) {\n    // 联机傀儡：纯位移外推\n    if (this.netPuppet) { this.netPuppetStep(); return; }\n    // extraUpdates=1（SetDefaults :5807）:AI/移动/命中每 tick 跑 2 次;-2 脱离态\n    // extraUpdates=0（:64739,克隆出生即脱离 → 单跑）\n    const iters = this.ai0 === -2 ? 1 : 2;\n    for (let i = 0; i < iters && !this.dead; i++) this.aiStep(game);\n  }\n\n  private aiStep(game: GameHooks) {\n    const p = this.ctx.owner();\n    if (!p || p.dead) { this.dead = true; return; }   // player.dead → Kill（:64490-64493）\n    this.handX = p.cx; this.handY = p.cy;\n    this.stringColor = p.equipStats?.stringColor ?? 0;\n    // num=250×0.5=125 轨道半径（:64477/:64482）;num3=15×0.8=12 速度上限;\n    // num4=12×1.5×0.5=9 速度下限（:64478-64483/:64531）;num5=num3=12 漂移钳\n    let num = 125;\n    const num3 = 12, num4 = 9, num5 = 12;\n    // 场上无悠悠球 → 回收（:64491-64506,owner 本机 && ai0>=0 门）\n    if (this.ai0 >= 0 && !this.ctx.yoyoInPlay()) this.ai0 = -1;\n    if (p.equipStats?.yoyoString) num += num * 0.25 + 10;   // :64486-64488\n    this.rot += 0.5;   // :64489\n    if (Number.isNaN(this.vx) || Number.isNaN(this.vy)) { this.dead = true; return; }\n    if (this.ai0 === 0 || this.ai0 === 1) {\n      if (this.ai0 === 1) num *= 0.75;   // 副球收紧轨道（:64532-64535）\n      let flag3 = false;\n      let dx = p.cx - this.cx, dy = p.cy - this.cy;\n      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);\n      if (d > num * 0.9 && this.ai0 !== -2) flag3 = true;   // :64536-64540（-2 检查恒假,照抄）\n      if (d > num) {\n        // 超径钳回（:64541-64550）：钳到轨道 + 速度径向衰减（去超出的 num6,至少留 1）\n        const over = d - num;\n        dx /= d || 1; dy /= d || 1;\n        this.x = p.cx - dx * num - this.w / 2;\n        this.y = p.cy - dy * num - this.h / 2;\n        const sp = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n        const cut = Math.min(over, Math.max(0, sp - 1));   // num6 钳（:64556）\n        if (sp > 0) { this.vx *= (sp - cut) / sp; this.vy *= (sp - cut) / sp; }\n        // 切向增速（:64552-64608）：vector2=(vy,vx) 按象限定号后并入速度方向\n        const sp0 = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n        if (sp0 > 0) {\n          let tx = this.vy, ty = this.vx;   // vector2 翻转\n          if (this.cy < p.cy) ty = Math.abs(ty); else if (this.cy > p.cy) ty = -Math.abs(ty);\n          if (this.cx < p.cx) tx = Math.abs(tx); else if (this.cx > p.cx) tx = -Math.abs(tx);\n          const tl = Math.hypot(tx, ty) || 1;\n          tx = tx / tl * sp0; ty = ty / tl * sp0;   // vector2 *= velocity.Length()\n          if (Math.abs(this.vx) > Math.abs(this.vy)) {\n            let nvx = this.vx, nvy = this.vy + ty;\n            const nl = Math.hypot(nvx, nvy) || 1;\n            nvx = nvx / nl * sp0; nvy = nvy / nl * sp0;\n            if (Math.abs(tx) < 0.1 || Math.abs(ty) < 0.1) { this.vx = nvx; this.vy = nvy; }\n            else { this.vx = (nvx + this.vx * 2) / 3; this.vy = (nvy + this.vy * 2) / 3; }\n          } else {\n            let nvx = this.vx + tx, nvy = this.vy;\n            const nl = Math.hypot(nvx, nvy) || 1;\n            nvx = nvx / nl * sp0; nvy = nvy / nl * sp0;\n            if (Math.abs(tx) < 0.2 || Math.abs(ty) < 0.2) { this.vx = nvx; this.vy = nvy; }\n            else { this.vx = (nvx + this.vx * 2) / 3; this.vy = (nvy + this.vy * 2) / 3; }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      // 鼠标位移反推（:64614-64642）：vector5=-(mouseDelta)×num2(0.1);velocity 非零才\n      // 生效;flag3 时清掉继续远离玩家的分量\n      if (this.ctx.channel()) {\n        const md = this.ctx.mouseDelta();\n        if (this.vx !== 0 || this.vy !== 0) {\n          let mx = -md.dx, my = -md.dy;   // flag 恒 true → ×-1（:64623-64626）\n          if (flag3) {\n            if (this.cx < p.cx && mx < 0) mx = 0;\n            if (this.cx > p.cx && mx > 0) mx = 0;\n            if (this.cy < p.cy && my < 0) my = 0;\n            if (this.cy > p.cy && my > 0) my = 0;\n          }\n          this.vx += mx * 0.1;\n          this.vy += my * 0.1;\n        }\n      } else {\n        this.ai0 = -1;   // 松手回收（:64643-64646）\n      }\n      // 800px 内最近敌追踪（:64643-64717;flag 恒真——配重球全走 num8=800 档;\n      // num11=|dx|+|dy| 曼哈顿距;敌距玩家 <num×0.9 且对球有视线）\n      {\n        let best = 800, tx = 0, ty = 0, found = false;\n        for (const ent of game.enemies()) {\n          if (!playerCanHitEnemy(ent, game)) continue;   // CanBeChasedBy :91070\n          const e = ent as { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; dead: boolean };\n          if (e.dead) continue;\n          const ecx = e.x + e.w / 2, ecy = e.y + e.h / 2;\n          const dist = Math.abs(this.cx - ecx) + Math.abs(this.cy - ecy);\n          if (dist >= best) continue;\n          if (!canHit(game.world.store, this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h, e.x, e.y, e.w, e.h)) continue;\n          if (Math.hypot(ecx - p.cx, ecy - p.cy) >= num * 0.9) continue;\n          best = dist; tx = ecx; ty = ecy; found = true;\n        }\n        if (found) {\n          let cdx = tx - this.cx, cdy = ty - this.cy;\n          const cd = Math.hypot(cdx, cdy) || 1;\n          cdx = cdx / cd * 6; cdy = cdy / cd * 6;   // v3 *= 6（:64710-64712）\n          this.vx = (this.vx * 7 + cdx) / 8;\n          this.vy = (this.vy * 7 + cdy) / 8;\n        }\n      }\n      // 速度钳 [num4=9, num3=12]（:64718-64726;零速保持零——SafeNormalize(Zero) 语义）\n      const sp = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n      if (sp > num3) { this.vx = this.vx / sp * num3; this.vy = this.vy / sp * num3; }\n      else if (sp > 0 && sp < num4) { this.vx = this.vx / sp * num4; this.vy = this.vy / sp * num4; }\n    }\n    // 魔法线（:64727-64733）：-1 回收态 + magicString → -3 幽灵 + 掷 75% 伤/击退脱离克隆\n    if (this.ai0 === -1 && p.equipStats?.magicString) {\n      this.ai0 = -3;\n      this.ctx.spawnClone?.(this.cx, this.cy, this.vx, this.vy,\n        Math.trunc(this.damage * 0.75), Math.trunc(this.knockback * 0.75), this.projId);\n    }\n    if (this.ai0 === -3) { this.ghost = true; this.damage = 0; }   // alpha=255 + damage=0（:64734-64737）\n    if (this.ai0 === -2) {\n      // 脱离坠落（:64738-64776）：penetrate=1（克隆一次命中即亡）;重力 0.3、速度上限\n      // 16、vy≤3 缓落水平漂移 ±0.1（num5 钳）\n      this.vy += 0.3;\n      const sp = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n      if (sp > 16) { this.vx = this.vx / sp * 16; this.vy = this.vy / sp * 16; }\n      else if (this.vy <= 3) {\n        if (Math.abs(this.vx) < 0.1) {\n          if (this.cx < p.cx) { this.vx -= 0.1; this.dir = -1; }\n          else { this.vx += 0.1; this.dir = 1; }\n        } else if (this.vx > 0 && this.vx < num5) this.vx += 0.1;\n        else if (this.vx < 0 && this.vx > -num5) this.vx -= 0.1;\n      }\n    } else if (this.ai0 < 0) {\n      // 回收（:64777-64824）：num13=num3×1.5=18 速、惯性 num14=12;\n      // 距玩家 <40 / NaN / >2000 → Kill;tileCollide=false 穿墙直积分\n      const dx = p.cx - this.cx, dy = p.cy - this.cy;\n      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);\n      if (d < 40 || Number.isNaN(d) || d > 2000) { this.dead = true; return; }\n      this.vx = (this.vx * 11 + (dx / (d || 1)) * 18) / 12;\n      this.vy = (this.vy * 11 + (dy / (d || 1)) * 18) / 12;\n      this.x += this.vx;\n      this.y += this.vy;\n      hitEnemies(this, game, this.hitCd, 10, Math.sign(this.vx) || 1, this.armorPen,\n        (e) => this.onHit(e));\n      return;\n    }\n    // 移动/碰撞（环绕与脱离态;回收态上方已直积分返回）\n    const lvx = this.vx, lvy = this.vy;\n    moveAndCollide(this, game.world, this.vx, this.vy);\n    if (this.ai0 === -2) {\n      // 脱离态撞块（:16988-17006）：竖撞 lastVy>4 → 弹起 ×-0.6;横撞 → HitTiles 尘 +\n      // SoundID 0 + Kill\n      if ((this.onGround || this.hitHead) && lvy > 4) this.vy = -lvy * 0.6;\n      if (this.hitWall) {\n        game.spawnParticles(this.cx, this.cy, '#A09080', 3, 1.5, { life: 14, size: 2 });   // HitTiles 尘\n        game.playSfx('dig', 1, this.cx, this.cy);   // SoundID 0\n        this.dead = true;\n        return;\n      }\n    } else if (this.hitWall || this.onGround || this.hitHead) {\n      // 环绕态撞块（:17005-17028）：逐轴反转 + 朝玩家合成 0.25 + 速度钳 6\n      if (this.hitWall) this.vx = -lvx;\n      if (this.onGround || this.hitHead) this.vy = -lvy;\n      let hx = p.cx - this.cx, hy = p.cy - this.cy;\n      const hd = Math.hypot(hx, hy) || 1;\n      const spd = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n      hx = hx / hd * spd * 0.25;   // v *= velocity.Length() × 0.25\n      hy = hy / hd * spd * 0.25;\n      this.vx = this.vx * 0.75 + hx;\n      this.vy = this.vy * 0.75 + hy;\n      const ns = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n      if (ns > 6) { this.vx *= 0.5; this.vy *= 0.5; }\n    }\n    hitEnemies(this, game, this.hitCd, 10, Math.sign(this.vx) || 1, this.armorPen,\n      (e) => this.onHit(e));\n  }\n\n  /** 命中链（Projectile.cs:12467-12508 aiStyle 99 段;-2 只被弹开,其余走\n   *  Counterweight 调用 + 方向定号 + ai0>=0 活跃反弹（localAI[0] += 20 段对配重球\n   *  无寿命语义,天然无效）） */\n  private onHit(e: unknown) {\n    const ecx = (e as { x: number; ```ts
  /** Player.Counterweight（Player.cs:11946-12004 1:1,悠悠球/配重球命中链调用）：
   *  ① yoyoGlove 且悠悠球数 <2 → 从玩家中心朝命中点 16 速掷【同型二号悠悠球】（ai0=1,
   *     伤害/击退取数组序最后一个悠悠球,:11973-11985）
   *  ② else if counterWeight >0 且配重球数 <悠悠球数 → 掷配重球（vanity 优先;
   *     kb=(kb+6)/2;已有在场 ai0=1 否则 0;速度同为朝命中点 16,:11986-12004）
   *  决策核 = counterweightDecision（WeaponProj 纯函数,可测）。 */
  private playerCounterweight(hitX: number, hitY: number, dmg: number, kb: number, src?: YoyoProj): void {
    const eq = this.player.equipStats;
    const play: CounterweightPlayView[] = [];
    let lastYoyo: YoyoProj | null = null;
    for (const q of this.entities.projectiles) {
      if (q.dead) continue;
      if (q instanceof CounterweightProj) play.push({ isWeight: true, ai0: q.ai0 });
      else if (q instanceof YoyoProj) { play.push({ isWeight: false, ai0: q.ai0 }); lastYoyo = q; }
    }
    const decision = counterweightDecision(eq, play, kb);
    if (decision.kind === 'second-yoyo' && lastYoyo) {
      const dx = hitX - this.player.cx, dy = hitY - this.player.cy;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const second = new YoyoProj(this.player.cx, this.player.cy, lastYoyo.damage, lastYoyo.knockback,
        lastYoyo.projId, 0,
        () => this.input.mouseHeld && !this.input.uiBlocking && this.player.inv.heldItem()?.id === lastYoyo.itemId,
        () => { const [wx, wy] = this.camera.screenToWorld(this.input.mouseX, this.input.mouseY); return { x: wx, y: wy }; });
      second.ai0 = 1;   // NewProjectile …, 1f（瞬态种子,活跃态首帧被光标目标覆写）
      second.critChance = lastYoyo.critChance;
      second.armorPen = lastYoyo.armorPen;
      this.wireYoyoCallbacks(second, lastYoyo.projId, lastYoyo.itemId);
      this.entities.add(second, 'projectiles');
    } else if (decision.kind === 'counterweight') {
      const dx = hitX - this.player.cx, dy = hitY - this.player.cy;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const cwE = new CounterweightProj(this.player.cx, this.player.cy, dmg, decision.kb,
        decision.type, decision.secondary ? 1 : 0, this.mkCounterweightCtx(src?.itemId));
      cwE.critChance = src?.critChance ?? 0.04;
      cwE.armorPen = src?.armorPen ?? 0;
      this.entities.add(cwE, 'projectiles');
    }
  }
```

```ts
  /** 悠悠球族 Game 侧回调接线（初掷/手套二号球/魔法线克隆三处共用）：
   *  secondInPlay（flag）/recallFamily（寿命广播）/spawnClone（魔法线）/counterweight（命中链）。 */
  private wireYoyoCallbacks(yoyo: YoyoProj, projId: number, itemId?: number): void {
    yoyo.itemId = itemId;
    yoyo.secondInPlay = () => this.entities.projectiles.some((q) =>
      q !== yoyo && !q.dead && q instanceof YoyoProj && q.projId === projId
      && q.ai0 >= -1 && q.id < yoyo.id);   // vanilla 槽序（whoAmI）≈ 实体出生序 id
    yoyo.recallFamily = () => {
      for (const q of this.entities.projectiles) {
        if (q.dead) continue;
        if (q instanceof YoyoProj && q.ai0 >= 0) q.ai0 = -1;
        else if (q instanceof CounterweightProj && q.ai0 >= 0) q.ai0 = -1;
      }
    };
    yoyo.spawnClone = (x, y, vx, vy, dmg, kb) => {
      const clone = new YoyoProj(x, y, dmg, kb, projId, 0,
        () => this.input.mouseHeld && !this.input.uiBlocking && (itemId === undefined || this.player.inv.heldItem()?.id === itemId),
        () => { const [wx, wy] = this.camera.screenToWorld(this.input.mouseX, this.input.mouseY); return { x: wx, y: wy }; });
      clone.ai0 = -2;   // NewProjectile …, -2f（脱离态出生,:65115）
      clone.critChance = yoyo.critChance;
      clone.armorPen = yoyo.armorPen;
      this.wireYoyoCallbacks(clone, projId, itemId);
      this.entities.add(clone, 'projectiles');
    };
    yoyo.counterweight = (hx, hy, d, k) => this.playerCounterweight(hx, hy, d, k, yoyo);
  }

### 关键勘误（相对任务背景）

- **"首次装备定死"不成立**：ResetEffects（:18288）每帧清零 counterWeight，UpdateEquips 每帧重掷——袋装期间颜色每帧重掷，命中时采样的是当帧值。实现为 getter 每访问一掷（消费点采样分布等价），已在注释说明。
- **"-2 免画线门已就位"不实**：原代码无条件画线；已在两处 draw() 补 `ai0 !== -2` 门（Main.cs:27799）。
- **magicString 语义**（:64727/:65110 查明）：松手回收时原球转 -3 隐身零伤幽灵飞回（线仍画），同时掷出 75% 伤/击退的 -2 脱离克隆自由坠落；AI_099_1 配重球有同款转移（克隆 penetrate=1）——两者均已实现。

### 遗留（及理由）

1. **-2 穿透不消耗于小动物/城镇 NPC 命中**：hitEnemies 的 critter/town 支路不回传统计；敌怪命中正确消耗。边缘场景（坠球擦过兔子）。
2. **-2 克隆 7200t 防泄漏上限**：原版 timeLeft=6 每帧刷新=真无限；沿用本仓既有防泄漏口径（有限寿命型号同款），撞墙/穿透尽为主要消亡路径。
3. **603 型号专属 AI（周期掷 604 副弹，:64856-64896/:12063 亦调 Counterweight）未接**：特定悠悠球的专属特效而非装备族，超出本任务范围，属既有缺口。
4. **heldProj/SetDummyItemRotation**（悠悠球持械动画/朝向）为引擎级既有缺口，未动。
5. **配重球鼠标反推用 CSS 像素位移**：与原版分辨率像素仅在有 DPR 缩放时数值不同（视觉摆动量级）。
6. **行为变化提示**：活跃悠悠球现按原版 tileCollide=true 撞墙滑动（此前穿墙）；配重球命中盒 18→10、贴图不再放大——均为原版数值。
